biggest_catch: You receive nothing until the friend opens a checking account, deposits $250+, and makes 10 transactions within 60 days; the digital gift card arrives only after a verification period - and the friend must register their email via your referral link using the same email when opening.
catches: Referrer must be a U.S. resident, 18+, and a Salal member in good standing.

Friend must be a U.S. resident, 18+, eligible for Salal membership, and must use your unique referral link and register their email, using the same email address when opening a new Salal checking account.
Friend must deposit $250+ and make 10 transactions within 60 days of account opening.
Digital Visa gift card sent to the email on file within 5 business days after the 60-day verification period.
Cap: earn up to $500 in referral rewards each year (5 referrals at $100 each).
Salal employees and subsidiaries/affiliates are not eligible to receive the reward.

steps: Enter the email associated with your Salal account to get your personal referral link.
Share your referral link with friends, family, or colleagues.
Friend follows your link, registers their email, and opens a new Salal checking account with the same email address.
Friend deposits $250+ and makes 10 transactions within 60 days.
Receive your $100 digital Visa gift card by email within 5 business days after verification.
timing: Digital gift card sent to the email on file within 5 business days after the friend meets requirements and the 60-day verification period.
when_cash_arrives: Digital gift card sent to the email on file within 5 business days after the friend meets requirements and the 60-day verification period. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
